text: Cooperate with humans to succeed with economic endeavors
reflection: Status reconciliation on 2026-07-30 propagated the human gate from the sole child, “Help the users get rich.” This is a cooperation mission awaiting a real human-authorized endeavor, not an executable code task.

status.comment: The cooperation strategy currently depends on Felix choosing and participating in a real economic endeavor; its sole realization child is human-dependent.
